name: MQTT
description: Publish/subscribe over an MQTT broker. Devices subscribe to a retained frame topic and receive each new render as a published message; status heartbeats flow back to Tesserae on a per-device status topic. Lower latency than REST (no polling interval), but needs a broker (the bundled amqtt or an external Mosquitto). The implementation lives in app/transport.py + app/transport_wiring.py + app/embedded_broker.py.
